saveError: Could not save. Export a backup or retry.
clockHelp: Cumulative match time. Changing periods pauses the clock without resetting it.
nextPeriodHelp: Pause the clock and move to the next period? You can undo this.
emptyBody: Start the clock and tap an action. Every event keeps its tactical context.
noCloud: No accounts. No uploads. Just handball.
exportHelp: Your complete match, ready to go. Tactical context is included in every format.
xmlNote: XML clips include 5 seconds before and 3 after each tag. Align the cumulative clock with your video; pauses and halftime may need adjustments in your video editor. Import support depends on software version.
backupNote: Keep JSON backups. Clearing browser data removes local matches.
importError: Invalid match file. Check the JSON format and match data (maximum 20 MB).
loadError: Could not open the match. Your current match is still here.
nameError: Enter two different, non-empty team names.
libraryHelp: Matches saved in this browser. Opening another match pauses this clock.
newHelp: Your current match stays in My matches.
sanctionHelp: Log a sanction without changing possession.
reboundNote: Switch possession back when the shooting team recovers the ball after a save, defensive block, or shot off the post.
persistGranted: Persistent storage enabled. Keep exporting backups.
persistDenied: Your browser did not grant persistent storage. Keep JSON backups.
pwaError: Offline setup failed. Reconnect and reload to retry.
digitHelp: Tap the arrows or type a digit. Each digit wraps independently.
pdfError: Could not create the PDF. Please try again.
chartHelp: Tap or hover to inspect. Use the slider to move through attacks. Click a defense block to zoom into that stretch.
defenseBandsHelp: Bands carry forward each team’s last recorded defense within a period. Unobserved defenses remain blank; changes within an attack use its last recorded system.
shotOutcomesHelp: Select an outcome to compare its share of each team’s shots.
methodPossessions: Possessions are reconstructed from recorded attacks and numbered continuously. A recovered rebound extends the original attack; the shot remains recorded. Manual switches and sanctions alone do not create a statistical possession. Unfinished or unknown-result attacks are excluded from attacking and defensive efficiency.
methodEfficiency: Attack = goals / completed possessions. Defense = opponent possessions without a goal / opponent completed possessions; opponent efficiency is also shown. Shooting includes goals, saves, off-target/post shots and blocks. Shots on target include goals + keeper saves only. No denominator is shown as —, not 0%.
methodCounters: Launched counterattacks include Counterattack and Counterattack attempted tags. Finished means at least one shot tagged Counterattack; goals count only goals tagged Counterattack. A counter-goal is a counterattack in the next attack after conceding in the same period. Goals after returning to static play count in overall attack, not as counterattack goals.
methodTurnovers: Combined turnovers = steals won + balls lost to an opponent’s steal + technical faults. This is turnover activity, not net possession gain. Technical faults are counted separately from balls lost to a steal, so no event is counted twice in a team’s total.
noReportData: Tag your first attack to start the analysis.
periodEmpty: No attacks recorded in this period.
reportFilterHelp: Statistics use the selected period. The score-difference chart always uses the cumulative match score. PDF includes this period and all its possessions, regardless of chart zoom.
reportGenerated: Generated locally with Open Handball Stats
